Dialogue_Text: "The battle took a while, and while the xvart necromancer tried to use all the tricks he had, it wasn't enough. He fell in the very same spot where his kin had fallen a couple of tendays ago. When he was gone, and so were his undead allies, the place became quiet again."
Who shall learn from this tale? Who shall learn how to protect themselves from the influence of even the darkest magic?
